S3_moveView.question: What happens to a WebContentsView added to a second BaseWindow?
S3_moveView.result: it leaves the first window on its own; script state, scroll position, input value and focus are kept; closing the first window afterwards leaves the view alive

S4_internalScheme.question: Can a privileged scheme be served on an in-memory session and stay unreachable from every other session?

defaultSession.topLevelLoad: does not load (empty url and title)

S5_focus.question: Does a pane that navigates while attached take focus from the pane the person is in?
S5_focus.result: yes; a view loaded detached and then attached does not
S5_focus.caveat: the test page has an autofocus input, which is what a real page can also have

S6_keys.question: What does the default application menu do in this shell, and does before-input-event see every key?

items: View(Reload Ctrl+R, Force Reload, Toggle Developer Tools Ctrl+Shift+I, zoom, F11)

withDefaultMenu.Ctrl+R: reloads the focused view, chrome view included; with the page focused the keys never reach before-input-event or the page
withDefaultMenu.beforeInputEvent: misses the keys the menu takes

withNullMenu.beforeInputEvent: sees every key in both the chrome view and the page view, including F12 and modifier keys

S6_keys.preventDefault: a page that would receive F12 receives nothing when before-input-event prevents it
